answer.rationale: Incumbent refusal plus a hard 18% spend cut and a non-auto-renewing primary that ends in 14 days leave renew, negotiate, and defer unable to meet cost or continuity. The low-cost quote meets the mandate; c2 is the load-bearing claim that a prior primary move was fast and clean, so it is the one record to verify. c1 still implies we give up known integration stability. No buffer at 94% utilization means any cutover can starve the line—risk is flagged and last year’s conditions may not match. With only one decision, dual-sourcing is not separately available; replacing the expiring primary is a full cutover, not a guarded test.
